messages:
maria: FYI I'm piloting a 'graceful drain + reacquire' playbook for spot GPU pools this week. Goal: reduce tail latency spikes when we lose nodes while avoiding immediate fallbacks to dedicated. Wanted quick feedback on thresholds.
doug: +1. What's the window and how aggressive are reacquire bids?
maria: Plan: detect high eviction probability (market signal or >8% 5m preempt rate) -> start streaming drain for running jobs with grace_period=180s -> checkpoint KV/cache to s3 (incremental) -> place reacquire bids on opportunistic price-optimized pools with a modest 2x bid factor for up to 3 attempts spaced 30s apart -> if reacquire fails, use warmbuffer (1-3 warm nodes) -> only if warmbuffer exhausted fallback to dedicated.
oliver: How do we avoid bid churn causing price spikes? price blowup risk.
maria: We cap total additional bid spend per-zone to 20% of baseline hourly spend for reacquire attempts. Also exponential backoff if measured eviction rate increases during attempts.
kaplan: We should have an autoscaler snippet to make this actionable.
maria: agreed, here's the rough config we're testing: 
```yaml
autoscaler:
  drain_grace: 180            # seconds to gracefully sync+hand off
  reacquire_attempts: 3      # try up to N times to re-get capacity
  reacquire_backoff_s: 30    # seconds between bid attempts
  max_reacquire_budget_pct: 20 # pct of baseline spend we can use for reacquire
  warmbuffer_size: 2         # number of prewarmed nodes per AZ
  warmbuffer_ttl_s: 900      # seconds to keep a warm node before releasing
```
infra-bot: added runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/graceful-drain (ops/runbooks) :book: 
sre_lead: Add metrics: `reacquire_success_rate`, `reacquire_spend_pct`, and alert if success_rate < 60% for 30m or spend_pct > 30% for 15m.
maria: good call — will emit metrics and wire alert to #eng-sre.
paul: Also include a canary plan: single region (us-west-2) with simulated preemptions to exercise checkpoint path and reacquire loop.
maria: test plan: canary today, 50% of spot fleets tomorrow, full rollout next Tue pending success. Will run 3 synthetic preemptions per canary window and measure tail p95/p99 and cost delta.
doug: Will observers need new dashboards?
maria: yes — add per-pool panels: reacquire_attempts, reacquire_success_rate, reacquire_spend, warmbuffer_utilization, drain_duration.
oliver: ensure checkpoints are incremental and non-blocking to avoid long pause for large models. Also prefer delta uploads to S3.
maria: ack — incremental snapshots + async upload.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary rollout for graceful-drain v0.1 by maria — see /deploys/1745556789
maria: running first canary now. ping me if you see unusual job restarts, large spike in egress (check incremental snapshots), or cost bump >8% vs baseline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
